type: Design briefs retained for the separate generated masters; concise briefs, not an assertion of verbatim full tool prompts
visual_system: Graphite background, cobalt accent, stationary English title on the left, precise geometric project illustration on the right. Native GitHub image assets; no custom README JavaScript.

covers.hero: Kirill Sotnikov / SOFTWARE / DATA / SYSTEMS. Graphite and cobalt cube/network cover matching the approved native GitHub profile.
covers.microbrain: A slim precise phone outline at right with a clean network of fact/rule nodes connected to a cobalt memory module, small precise vector-like geometric forms.
covers.pitomo: An original small white paw motif with a clean geometric commerce flow: catalog tiles to shopping cart to package/order document. Thin white connectors and cobalt solid panels. Abstract schematic, not a screenshot.
covers.demand: A compact clean time-series plot on right: thin white observed line, cobalt forecast line and an understated calendar grid, no axis numbers, no invented values. Abstract analytical cover, no performance claim.
covers.route: An isometric geometric weighted tile grid at right with one cobalt segmented path around dark blocked tiles; thin white outlines and a few cobalt destination nodes. Abstract grid pathfinding, no geographic map.
covers.vision: An abstract white outlined image frame at right with geometric subject silhouette, cobalt corner brackets and a second unfilled candidate frame connected by fine lines. Express uncertainty and human review without fake confidence scores.
covers.text: Three compact abstract geometric modules at right: document lines, linked duplicate fingerprints, a split dataset grid. Fine white network edges and cobalt accent blocks, no tiny text or invented metrics.
